pages.title: Entanglement Tuner
pages.text: A slim instrument with a dial that sets which entangled channel a transceiver listens on. Entanglement cannot carry a message by itself, but it can share a key and a correlation; the tuner makes two devices agree on which pair of photons they share. It clicks softly between settings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My transceivers kept pairing with whichever partner was nearest. I mounted an entangled photon pair and a quantum dot on a neutronium plate as a reference, so every device I tune shares the same correlated source and stays on one channel.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Cryptography.
